item.title: Daycare Ratios and Capacity 2026: The Real Enrollment Math
item.description: Most people opening a daycare think the size of their revenue is a marketing question — fill the rooms and the money follows. It isn’t. Your maximum revenue is set the day you sign the lease, by two numbers you don’t control: your state’s child-to-staff ratios and the usable square footage of your rooms. Marketing only decides how fast you reach a ceiling that’s already fixed in the licensing code.
